_meta.source_document: LIMEN Helix — Comprehensive Neurology & Nervous System Reference (Jul 2026). THIS DOCUMENT ONLY. Domain-generic sections copied verbatim from finance-neuro-substrate.json (which copied them verbatim from energy-neuro-substrate.json).
_meta.additive_contract: Purely additive overlay. Does NOT modify assets/data/domains/technology.json or any existing technology file. References existing Technology node IDs and issue IDs by value only. Mirrors the Energy/Finance neuro-substrate overlay shape for the Technology domain.
_meta.advisory_only: This overlay is ADVISORY. It classifies existing authored circuits against the source document's Part XIV failure taxonomy and runs the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test. It writes nothing back and changes no live behavior on load.

heterogeneity_flagged: CYBER_ATTACK and DATA_BREACH — UNMAPPED. Both are ADVERSARIAL / information-integrity failures (a deliberate external attacker: coordinated cyber assault; mass data exfiltration). None of the 9 Part XIV classes (all E/I-dynamics archetypes: excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation) expresses an adversary-driven / stolen-signal / breach-of-confidentiality failure. Marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit. THIS IS THE KEY FINDING, and it is STRONGER than in Finance: Technology carries TWO adversarial-archetype issues (33% of its issue set) versus Finance's ONE (FRAUD_SCANDAL, ~17%). The neuro-substrate taxonomy structurally cannot represent an adversary.

INFRASTRUCTURE_COLLAPSE — its _authored circuit [THAL, CC, DMN, ECN, S1] contains NO node from the REGULATORY_NODES set, so it FAILS the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test (verdict INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT). This differs from Finance, where all 6 authored circuits passed (6/6). Technology's headline incomplete-circuit result is 5/6, not 6/6. The circuit is an all-hypoactive relay/routing/cloud/OS/sensor chain with no brake, feedback, or extinction arm — lesioned in exactly the sense Part XIV names.

CYBER_ATTACK and DATA_BREACH node cues diverge from the (UNMAPPED) classification. CYBER_ATTACK's canonical node LC[Hyper] ('broadcast/alerting — gain stuck high=thrash') reads as an alerting/oscillatory hyperactivation, but that describes the DEFENSIVE alarm response, not the adversarial assault itself. DATA_BREACH's canonical node PAG[Hypo] ('defensive kill/lockdown — no-stop') reads as DISINHIBITION (loss of the lockdown brake), but that too describes only the failed defensive response, not the exfiltration by an adversary. In both, the dynamical node cue captures the reaction; the ISSUE's driving mechanism is an external adversary, which no class can hold.

INFRASTRUCTURE_COLLAPSE classed on its NODE cue (THAL gate-stuck-closed -> GATING_FAILURE); its SUMMARY names a DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS element ('cascading failure across interconnected systems... interdependent services collapse sequentially'). Divergence recorded, not resolved by guessing.

PLATFORM_MONOPOLY classed on its NODE cue (GP[Hyper] 'output gate — flood' -> GATING_FAILURE, flood variant); it also reads as loss of lateral inhibition / winner-take-all dominance (a DISINHIBITION flavor). Divergence recorded.

CANONICAL single-node circuits: 5 of 6 issues have a canonical circuit whose sole node is NOT in REGULATORY_NODES (LC, TPJ, THAL, PAG, THAL) and would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; only PLATFORM_MONOPOLY's canonical node (GP) is a regulatory node. The _authored circuits are what the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() runs, so the diagnostic is on _authored.
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Technology-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

issue_failure_class_map._basis: GROUNDED: each mapping uses the Technology issue's OWN text (canonical circuit detail and/or summary, quoted in technology_text) plus the document's Part XIV named class. No new class was invented. Where the issue text names a mechanism with no analog among the 9 classes (adversary-driven attack / breach), it is marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit.
issue_failure_class_map._count: 4 grounded, 2 UNMAPPED (of 6 issues). The 2 UNMAPPED are exactly the adversarial / information-integrity issues.

CYBER_ATTACK.reason: Issue names an ADVERSARIAL mechanism with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
CYBER_ATTACK.technology_text: canonical circuit LC[Hyper]: "broadcast / alerting — gain stuck high=thrash"; summary: "Coordinated cyber assault targeting critical infrastructure, financial systems, or government networks causing widespread disruption and data compromise"
CYBER_ATTACK.reasoning: 'Coordinated cyber assault' is a deliberate EXTERNAL ADVERSARY compromising and disrupting systems. The 9 Part XIV classes are all dynamical-failure archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); none expresses an adversary-driven / stolen-or-sabotaged-signal failure. Forcing it into any of the 9 would be a guess. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
CYBER_ATTACK.note: KEY HETEROGENEITY FINDING (shared with DATA_BREACH). The canonical node cue LC[Hyper] 'gain stuck high=thrash' reads as an alerting/oscillatory hyperactivation, but that captures the DEFENSIVE alarm response ('Cybersecurity teams in full incident response mode', _authored CeA[Hyper]), not the adversarial assault that drives the issue. The E/I-dynamics taxonomy structurally cannot represent an attacker.

AI_ALIGNMENT_FAILURE.subtype: brake-fail -> rogue runaway (loss of the stop/brake)
AI_ALIGNMENT_FAILURE.technology_text: _authored FPN[Hyper-active]: "AI systems operating beyond intended capability boundaries with insufficient human oversight"; _authored dlPFC[Hyper-active]: "Software engineering teams scrambling to implement guardrails on systems already deployed at scale"; summary: "Advanced AI systems exhibiting behavior misaligned with human values, from subtle bias amplification to autonomous action beyond intended boundaries"
AI_ALIGNMENT_FAILURE.reasoning: The named mechanism is autonomous action BEYOND intended boundaries with INSUFFICIENT oversight, with guardrails (the brake) missing and being retrofitted after deployment. Losing the top-down inhibitory brake and releasing rogue/runaway behavior is the exact DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition (loss of the stop/brake). Mirrors Finance CURRENCY_COLLAPSE's 'brake-fail=rogue' mapping.
AI_ALIGNMENT_FAILURE.note: The canonical NODE cue is TPJ[Hypo] 'social attribution & reorienting — mindblindness', a perception / theory-of-mind deficit that is not cleanly one of the 9 classes; classed on the dominant _authored mechanism (loss of oversight brake), and the node/authored divergence is flagged, not guessed away.

INFRASTRUCTURE_COLLAPSE.technology_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; _authored THAL[Hypo-active]: "Data centers experiencing power or cooling failures, taking hosted services offline"; _authored CC[Hypo-active]: "Internet backbone connectivity severed, isolating regions from global network"
INFRASTRUCTURE_COLLAPSE.reasoning: The primary node is a routing RELAY stuck closed, starving everything downstream; the _authored circuit is dominated by Hypo-active (shut-down / starved) relay, routing, cloud, OS-emergency, and sensor nodes. Gate stuck closed producing downstream starvation is the GATING_FAILURE archetype (gate stuck closed -> starvation), matching Energy's gating-relay stuck-closed mapping and Finance's BANKING_CRISIS/CREDIT_FREEZE.
INFRASTRUCTURE_COLLAPSE.note: The SUMMARY also names a DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS element ('Cascading failure across interconnected technology systems... interdependent services collapse sequentially'). Classed on the dominant node cue (gate stuck-closed = GATING_FAILURE); the network-cascade/diaschisis divergence is flagged. SEPARATELY, this issue's _authored circuit FAILS the incomplete-circuit test (no regulatory node) — see incomplete_circuit_diagnostic.

DATA_BREACH.reason: Issue names an ADVERSARIAL mechanism with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
DATA_BREACH.technology_text: canonical circuit PAG[Hypo]: "defensive kill/lockdown — no-stop"; summary: "Mass exfiltration of sensitive personal, financial, or classified data exposing millions to identity theft, fraud, and privacy violation"
DATA_BREACH.reasoning: 'Mass exfiltration of sensitive data' is a deliberate breach of confidentiality by an EXTERNAL ADVERSARY: data is stolen, not merely mis-gated or over-excited. The 9 Part XIV classes are all dynamical-failure archetypes; none expresses theft / breach / stolen-signal. Forcing it into any of the 9 would be a guess. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
DATA_BREACH.note: KEY HETEROGENEITY FINDING (shared with CYBER_ATTACK). The canonical node cue PAG[Hypo] 'no-stop' reads as DISINHIBITION (loss of the lockdown brake), but that captures only the failed defensive response ('Security operations centers in crisis response', _authored CeA[Hyper]), not the exfiltration that drives the issue. Technology thus carries TWO adversarial issues to Finance's one.

CHIP_SHORTAGE.technology_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; _authored STRI[Hypo-active]: "Semiconductor fabrication capacity insufficient to meet demand, with multi-year lead times for new fabs"; _authored THAL[Hypo-active]: "Data center expansion frozen as server and networking equipment delivery timelines extend to years"
CHIP_SHORTAGE.reasoning: A supply relay stuck closed starves every downstream consumer: the _authored circuit is entirely Hypo-active (fabrication, hardware design, robotics, IoT, data centers all starved). Gate stuck closed -> starvation is the GATING_FAILURE archetype. This is the strongest grounding of the grounded set; it mirrors Finance CREDIT_FREEZE (supply starvation) almost exactly.
CHIP_SHORTAGE.note: Not adversarial: this is an ordinary supply-deficit starvation, cleanly a dynamical GATING_FAILURE.

PLATFORM_MONOPOLY.subtype: gate-flood -> too little filtering (over-permissive gate / loss of gated competition)
PLATFORM_MONOPOLY.technology_text: canonical circuit GP[Hyper]: "basal-ganglia output gate — flood"; _authored DMN[Hyper-active]: "Cloud computing dominated by three providers whose outages affect entire sectors of the global economy"; summary: "Concentration of digital infrastructure and services under a handful of corporations creating single points of failure, rent-seeking, and innovation suppression"
PLATFORM_MONOPOLY.reasoning: The named mechanism is an OUTPUT GATE in flood (GP[Hyper], 'output gate — flood'): too little filtering, one channel dominating throughput. The GATING_FAILURE definition explicitly covers this ('too little filtering -> flooding'). The _authored circuit shows the dominant channel (DMN[Hyper], cloud) flooding while competitors (TPJ open-source, dlPFC independent dev) are Hypo-active — a gate that no longer filters/balances.
PLATFORM_MONOPOLY.note: Also reads as loss of LATERAL inhibition / winner-take-all dominance (a DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME flavor): concentration = collapse of the competition that normally keeps any one node from dominating. Classed on the explicit GP 'flood' node cue; the disinhibition/lateral divergence is flagged. NOTE: PLATFORM_MONOPOLY is the ONLY issue whose canonical single node (GP) is itself a REGULATORY node.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against technology.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses _authored node list).
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: PASS 5/6. Five authored circuits include at least one regulatory/feedback node; ONE (INFRASTRUCTURE_COLLAPSE) does NOT and is verdict INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT. This DIFFERS from Finance (6/6 PASS) and Energy (6/6): Technology has a genuinely incomplete authored circuit. NOTE: 5 of 6 issues have CANONICAL single-node circuits (LC, TPJ, THAL, PAG, THAL) that are bare non-regulatory nodes and WOULD fail canonical-only; only PLATFORM_MONOPOLY's canonical node (GP) is regulatory.

CYBER_ATTACK.observation: Circuit is complete (HIPP memory/feedback present), yet the issue is UNMAPPED in the failure-class map: a circuit can be structurally complete under the incomplete-circuit test and still express a failure archetype (adversarial attack) outside the 9-class taxonomy. The two diagnostics are independent. Canonical single-node circuit is LC[Hyper] alone (NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE if run canonical-only.

AI_ALIGNMENT_FAILURE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is TPJ[Hypo] alone (NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE if run canonical-only; _authored supplies dACC/dlPFC oversight.

INFRASTRUCTURE_COLLAPSE.observation: THE ONE FAILING CIRCUIT. No node in [THAL, CC, DMN, ECN, S1] is a member of REGULATORY_NODES (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM). The circuit is an all-relay/routing/cloud/OS/sensor chain (4 Hypo-active + 1 Hyper-active emergency node) with NO brake, feedback, or extinction arm. Per Part XIV it is lesioned in the same way a brain is. This is the substantive difference from Finance/Energy (both 6/6).

DATA_BREACH.observation: Structurally complete (HIPP present), but UNMAPPED in the failure-class map (adversarial breach outside the taxonomy). Canonical single-node circuit is PAG[Hypo] alone (NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE if run canonical-only.

CHIP_SHORTAGE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is THAL[Hypo] alone (NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE if run canonical-only; _authored supplies CBLM (forward-model error-correct).

PLATFORM_MONOPOLY.observation: The only issue whose CANONICAL single node (GP) is itself regulatory, so it would PASS canonical-only too; _authored supplies dlPFC.

parameter_table._note: Part XV, verbatim. Quantitative substrate for scale-rescaling. Confidence + anchor preserved.

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Technology mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation, or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
